description: OpenCaseLaw retrieval/cache adapter for LexMachina Frontier query-specific query map MVP

search_decisions.signature: search_decisions(query: str, limit: int = 50, use_cache: bool = True, max_pages: int = 6, page_size: int = 50) -> Tuple[List[dict], str, bool]
search_decisions.description: Broad retrieval from OpenCaseLaw MCP public REST API. Returns (decisions_list, provenance_note, from_cache_bool). Caches results file-line for deterministic offline testing. Rate-limited to <=5 req/s.

parameters.query: Swiss legal question string (e.g., 'Kündigung Mietrecht', 'licenziement invalidité')
parameters.limit: Configurable target up to 300 decisions (6 pages x 50 per page). Without violating documented rate limits.
parameters.use_cache: If True, try file-cached results first for deterministic/offline testing
parameters.max_pages: Pagination depth (50 per page => up to 300 with 6 pages)

search_decisions.returns: (decisions, provenance, from_cache) where decisions is a list of dicts with fields: decision_id, court, language, decision_date, docket_number, title, regeste, snippet, source_url, citation_string, citation_count, provenance

fetch_decision_detail.description: Lazily fetch full decision metadata from OpenCaseLaw MCP for a single selected candidate. Never raises - returns minimal record on failure.
fetch_decision_detail.returns: Dict with fields: decision_id, court, language, decision_date, docket_number, title, regeste, abstract_de/fr/it, cited_decisions, citation_count, citation_string_de/fr/it, legal_area, proceeding_type, court_name, canton, chamber, source_url, provenance

expand_citation_neighborhood.signature: expand_citation_neighborhood(decisions: List[dict], max_new: int = 20, max_per_decision: int = 5) -> List[dict]
expand_citation_neighborhood.description: Add incoming/outgoing/leading-case candidates from cited decision graphs. Bounded by max_new total and max_per_decision per source decision. Returns additional decision dicts with provenance tracking.

parameters.max_new: Maximum total new candidates to add
parameters.max_per_decision: Maximum new candidates per source decision

expand_citation_neighborhood.returns: List of additional decision dicts with neighbor_role='cited-by' and provenance tracking

expand_query.description: Return provenance-preserving query variants with DE/FR/IT conceptually related terms. Does NOT fabricate translations; only boosts cross-language recall.
expand_query.returns: List of query variants [original, original + expansion_terms, ...]

normalize_decision.signature: normalize_decision(d: dict, rank: int, score: float = 0.0) -> dict
normalize_decision.description: Normalize a raw OpenCaseLaw decision dict into the query_result_bundle contract format. Ensures all REQUIRED_DECISION keys are present. Missing values get safe defaults.

parameters.d: Raw decision dict from OpenCaseLaw search or detail

normalize_decision.returns: Dict with all REQUIRED_DECISION keys: decision_id, court, language, rank, score, provenance, snippet, cluster_id, x, y, counter_status, canonical_url, citation, plus extra fields: court_name, decision_date, docket_number, title, regeste

build_bundle_from_decisions.signature: build_bundle_from_decisions(query: str, decisions: List[dict], query_variants: Optional[List[str]] = None, top_n: int = 120, expand_cites: bool = True, cite_limit: int = 20) -> dict
build_bundle_from_decisions.description: Central normalization contract (ARCHITECTURE.md / QUERY_MAP_MVP.md). Returns a dict compliant with bundle.validate_bundle(). Central produces: query, query_variants, answer (extractive), decisions (normalized, deduped, ranked), clusters (TF-IDF projection), relations (citation edges), provenance (full trace).

parameters.decisions: List of decision dicts from search_decisions
parameters.query_variants: Optional multilingual variants (generated by expand_query if None)
parameters.top_n: Maximum decisions to include in bundle (configurable up to 300)
parameters.cite_limit: Maximum new citation neighbors to add

build_bundle_from_decisions.returns: Bundle dict with fields: bundle_version, query, query_variants, answer, decisions, clusters, relations, provenance. Compliant with bundle.validate_bundle().

rate_limiting.per_client: Shared in-memory rate limit store, client ID = source IP
